They were placed in extended judicial custody after being detained for entering Jantar Mantar illegally. The Cockroach Janta Party claims that the delay in bail proceedings is intentional to keep them imprisoned. CJP representatives argue that their clients should not remain behind bars due to political motivations.

The competition featured athletes from different classifications competing together for fairness in standings.

Speaking at a Faith Leaders Conference in New York, Bhagwat encouraged the embrace of diverse communities, including Muslims, reiterating the value of dignity for all. Annamalai pointed out the rising global fascination with Indian civilization, stressing the necessity for leaders and citizens to embody the nation's established ideals.

description: As the government gears up for a new delimitation effort, Congress’s quest for opposition unity faces hurdles. Congress chief Mallikarjun Kharge raised alarms about the government's legislative strategies pertaining to delimitation and reservations for women. With Kiren Rijiju hinting at discussions across various opposition factions that may favor the bills, the scenario presents a complex web of political dynamics.

The incident occurred on Saturday night when the accused confronted the victim at his workplace. The accused were identified as Farooq, Sonu, and Ishan after the victim reported the incident. Relevant sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita were invoked as part of the charges. Police are currently conducting an investigation into the matter.

description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio's recent arrival in India marked a pivotal moment for trade and energy discussions. He expressed confidence in finalizing a trade deal and recognized India's vital position in refining Venezuelan oil. Furthermore, Rubio tackled military assistance to Ukraine and stressed the need for arms control conversations involving China and Russia, illustrating the deepening geopolitical ties between the United States and India.

She has since conquered treks to Kedarnath and Amarnath, showcasing her unwavering spirit. With aspirations to explore all twelve Jyotirlingas, Nehaa's journey highlights the path to independence and serves as a beacon of inspiration for others.

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: In 2024, a cook employed at a 5-star hotel in Delhi received an income tax notice demanding nearly Rs 4 crore in tax, along with a penalty for under-reporting income. The notice alleged that the man had made cash sales worth Rs 24.62 crore through a company dealing in packing materials.  He immediately checked his Form 26AS to understand why such a large transaction was linked to his tax records.

description: The stunning portrait of Ghulam Nasir al-Din, famously known as Kale Miyan, fetched an impressive £63,500 at Christie's auction. Created between 1851 and 1852, this significant painting not only depicts a key religious figure but also highlights his profound spiritual essence. The artwork exceeded auction projections, underscoring its historical value. Interestingly, the back of the painting features sketches of boats, adding to its artistic allure.

description: In 2029, a comprehensive renovation of the Toledo Swing Bridge is set to begin, aimed at boosting freight operations. Key structural enhancements will enable the bridge to support heavier railcars, thereby improving efficiency in transportation. The airline's assertion of the passenger being a no-show lacked proof. As a result, the commission instructed British Airways to refund the ticket price, provide compensation, and pay litigation costs, obligating compliance within 30 days.

The incident occurred while she was asleep, leading to critical injuries. Shazia's mother immediately took her to the hospital for treatment after the shooting. The father was arrested soon after the incident was reported to the police.
title: Refused arranged marriage, UP man shoots 19-year-old daughter in head

author: TIMESOFINDIA.COM
description: A UK football club official is facing a court battle with his upstairs neighbour over a 24ft garden room built in 2018 with a bar, television and electric doorbell. Justin Salmon altered the structure after a tribunal found it breached his lease, but neighbour Andrianna Neophytou says the changes are insufficient and wants it demolished. Legal costs could exceed £100,000.
